_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: Score is coiled inside Denial with 12/12 HOLD record and funding still +0.01%; downside fuel exists but the liquidation breaker has not fired, so rung stays put.
next_move.brains_agree: partial — analyst explicit HOLD in Denial; narrative only supplies risk-off metals selloff color without a phase call
next_move.confirmed_if: Phase score remains 32-38, funding non-negative, BTC fails reclaim of 76739
next_move.invalidated_if: Funding flips negative and long/short percentile rolls over (score <32 into Panic), or ETF/stablecoin bid reclaims and lifts score into Anxiety
